$comment: THE SHARED SAFE-ID FIXTURE. One list of cases, asserted identically by every mirror of the id guard: `packages/skill-runtime/tests/path-safety.test.ts`, `apps/cli/tests/paths.test.ts`, and `workers/indexer-python/tests/test_harness.py`. The guard is duplicated on purpose (each entrypoint is independently invocable, so a guard living only in the caller is a guard with a documented bypass) — but three copies with three separate test suites is how they drift, and they DID: Python's `$` also matches before a trailing newline while JavaScript's does not, so `"abc\n"` was accepted by the worker and rejected by the CLI. Nothing pinned them to each other until this file. Add a case here and all three suites must agree about it.
